scope: Captured BIS and FSSAI packaged-water documents only

questions.query: Which Indian Standard covers packaged drinking water other than packaged natural mineral water?

evidence.quote: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification ACCORDING TO IS 14543:2024

questions.query: Which Indian Standard covers packaged natural mineral water?

evidence.quote: Packaged Natural Mineral Water — Specification ACCORDING TO IS 13428:2024

questions.query: How does a domestic packaged drinking water manufacturer apply for a BIS licence?
questions.expected_answer: Apply online through Manakonline using Form V under Scheme I; the manual states that applications are accepted under the normal procedure.

evidence.quote: Domestic manufacturers of PDW shall apply for grant of licence for his unit online through the Manakonline system as per the provided application format i.e. as per Form V

questions.query: How does a domestic packaged natural mineral water manufacturer apply for a BIS licence?
questions.expected_answer: Apply online through Manakonline using Form V under Scheme I; the manual states that applications are accepted under the normal procedure.

evidence.quote: Domestic manufacturers of PNMW shall apply for grant of licence for his unit online through the Manakonline system as per the provided application format i.e. as per Form V

questions.query: What sources can water for IS 14543 packaged drinking water come from?
questions.expected_answer: Surface water, civic water supply, underground water, sea water, or another consistent source identified during inspection.

evidence.quote: Water shall be derived from surface water or civic water supply or underground water or sea water or any other consistent source of water.

questions.query: What are the two activities in BIS surveillance for packaged water certification?
questions.expected_answer: Factory surveillance, including testing a factory sample, and drawing market samples for third-party laboratory testing.

evidence.quote: Surveillance consists of two activities in case of Packaged water certification i.e. surveillance visits at factory premises (which includes testing of sample drawn from factory) and drawl of samples from the market for third party lab testing.

questions.query: Which requirements are preferably checked during preliminary factory testing of packaged drinking water?
questions.expected_answer: Description, colour, odour, taste, turbidity, pH, chloride, alkalinity and residual free chlorine.

evidence.quote: Description, Colour, Odour, Taste, Turbidity, pH, Chloride, Alkalinity, and Residual Free Chlorine.

questions.query: How should an officer check that a packaged drinking water market sample bears a genuine ISI mark?
questions.expected_answer: Check the licence number printed on the label; do not draw a sample carrying a spurious mark and initiate suitable action.

evidence.quote: This may be done by checking the licence number printed on the label. In case it is found that the ISI mark is spurious, the sample shall not be drawn for testing

questions.query: What laboratory capability must a packaged drinking water manufacturer maintain?
questions.expected_answer: A suitably equipped laboratory staffed with competent testing personnel able to perform the specified Indian Standard test methods.

evidence.quote: A laboratory shall be maintained which shall be suitably equipped and staffed with competent testing person(s) to carry out the different tests in accordance with the methods given in the Indian standards.

questions.query: What calibration responsibility does the packaged drinking water manufacturer have?
questions.expected_answer: The manufacturer must prepare and implement a calibration plan for test equipment.

evidence.quote: The manufacturer shall prepare and implement a calibration plan for the test equipment.

questions.query: May a packaged drinking water label contain claims prohibited by IS 14543:2024?
questions.expected_answer: No. Labels and secondary packaging must not contain claims prohibited by clause 7.2 of IS 14543:2024.

evidence.quote: The label on the bottles/containers/pouches and/or the secondary packaging shall not contain claims which are prohibited as per clause 7.2 of IS14543:2024.

questions.query: What must a packaged drinking water manufacturer do before using a new source of raw water?
questions.expected_answer: Inform BIS, test the new raw water and processed water, and submit the reports for approval before regular production and marking.

evidence.quote: The reports of source water and the product water produced from the new source shall be submitted to BIS for approval before commissioning for regular production and marking.

questions.query: What records support a declared packaged drinking water shelf life?
questions.expected_answer: The declaration must be based on an in-house shelf-life study with records maintained to support the declared period.

evidence.quote: It shall be based on in-house shelf life study for which proper records be maintained conforming to declared shelf life.

questions.query: What location risks are checked for a packaged drinking water processing facility?
questions.expected_answer: The checklist asks whether the site is free from objectionable odour, smoke, dust or other contaminants and is not subject to flooding.

evidence.quote: Is the facility location area free from objectionable odour, smoke, dust or other contaminants and not subject to flooding?

questions.query: How does the BIS manual characterize natural mineral water?
questions.expected_answer: It is obtained from natural or drilled underground sources, has characteristic mineral composition, is collected to preserve purity and is packaged near the source subject to the permitted treatments.

evidence.quote: is obtained directly from natural or drilled sources from underground water-bearing strata

questions.query: What approval is required before natural mineral water from a new source enters regular production?
questions.expected_answer: Source and product water reports must be submitted to BIS for approval before commissioning regular production and marking.

evidence.quote: The reports of source water and the product water produced from the new source shall be submitted to BIS for approval before commissioning for regular production and marking.

questions.query: Which regulation section is the FSSAI packaged drinking water testing scheme based on?

evidence.quote: SCHEME OF TESTING FOR PACKAGED DRINKING WATER (OTHER THAN PACKAGED NATURAL MINERAL WATER) IN ACCORDANCE WITH FSSR 2.10.8.

questions.query: Which regulation section is the FSSAI mineral water testing scheme based on?

evidence.quote: SCHEME OF TESTING FOR MINERAL WATER IN ACCORDANCE WITH FSSR 2.10.7.

questions.query: Which packaging rules apply to plastic containers used for packaged drinking water under the captured FSSAI scheme?
questions.expected_answer: They must conform to the Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulation, 2018.

evidence.quote: The plastic containers used for packing the material shall conform to Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulation, 2018.

questions.query: Which reused containers may be used for mineral water under the captured FSSAI scheme?
questions.expected_answer: Durable, cleanable or disinfectable plastic containers of at least 5 litres and glass bottles; soiled, deformed or mutilated containers must not be reused.

evidence.quote: Licensee shall ensure use of plastic containers of capacity 5 litre and above & glass bottles only which are suitably durable, easy to clean or disinfect for packing the product water.

questions.query: What is the minimum declared shelf life for packaged drinking water in the BIS product manual?
questions.expected_answer: At least 30 days.

evidence.quote: Declared shelf life for Packaged Drinking Water in all type of packing materials shall not be less than 30 days.

questions.query: What is the minimum declared shelf life for natural mineral water in the BIS product manual?
questions.expected_answer: At least 30 days.

evidence.quote: Declared shelf life for Natural Mineral Water in all type of packing materials shall not be less than 30 days.

questions.query: Approximately how much packaged water is adequate for independent testing when containers are one litre or smaller?
questions.expected_answer: Approximately 18 litres, supplied in two parts.

evidence.quote: A sample containing approximately 18 litres of packaged water (PDW/PNMW) in two parts is adequate, if packed in 1 liter or smaller containers

questions.query: How often does the captured FSSAI scheme require coliform testing for packaged drinking water?
questions.expected_answer: One sample once a month.

evidence.quote: Coliform Bacteria One Once in a month

questions.query: How often is nitrate tested in the packaged drinking water table?
questions.expected_answer: One sample once every three months.

evidence.quote: v. Nitrate (as NO3) One Once in three months

questions.query: How often must all packaged drinking water parameters be tested under Note 2 of the FSSAI scheme?
questions.expected_answer: Once every six months.

evidence.quote: All the parameters defined for Packaged Drinking Water under regulation 2.10.8 of FSS (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulation, 2011, shall be tested once in a six months

questions.query: After a non-compliant six-month packaged drinking water result, what temporary testing frequency applies and when can it stop?
questions.expected_answer: Increase testing to once a month until three consecutive batches for that parameter comply.

evidence.quote: the frequency to be increase to once in a month, till 3 consecutive batches on the same test parameter are found compliant.

questions.query: How often are coliform bacteria tested for mineral water in the captured FSSAI table?
questions.expected_answer: One sample once a month.

evidence.quote: Coliform Bacteria One

questions.query: How often is nitrate tested for mineral water in the captured FSSAI table?
questions.expected_answer: One sample once every three months.

evidence.quote: Nitrate (as NO3) One

questions.query: How often must all mineral water parameters be tested under Note 2 of the FSSAI scheme?
questions.expected_answer: Once every six months.

evidence.quote: All the parameters defined for Mineral Water under regulation 2.10.7 of FSS (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulation, 2011, shall be tested once in a six months

questions.query: पैकेज्ड ड्रिंकिंग वाटर के लिए कौन सा भारतीय मानक लागू होता है?

evidence.quote: Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification ACCORDING TO IS 14543:2024

questions.query: ప్యాకేజ్డ్ నేచురల్ మినరల్ వాటర్‌కు ఏ భారతీయ ప్రమాణం వర్తిస్తుంది?

evidence.quote: Packaged Natural Mineral Water — Specification ACCORDING TO IS 13428:2024

questions.query: FSSAI पैकेज्ड ड्रिंकिंग वाटर परीक्षण योजना किस नियम के अनुसार है?
questions.expected_answer: FSSR 2.10.8

evidence.quote: SCHEME OF TESTING FOR PACKAGED DRINKING WATER (OTHER THAN PACKAGED NATURAL MINERAL WATER) IN ACCORDANCE WITH FSSR 2.10.8.

questions.query: FSSAI మినరల్ వాటర్ పరీక్ష పథకం ఏ నియమం ప్రకారం ఉంది?
questions.expected_answer: FSSR 2.10.7

evidence.quote: SCHEME OF TESTING FOR MINERAL WATER IN ACCORDANCE WITH FSSR 2.10.7.

questions.query: पैकेज्ड ड्रिंकिंग वाटर की न्यूनतम घोषित शेल्फ लाइफ कितनी है?
questions.expected_answer: कम से कम 30 दिन

evidence.quote: Declared shelf life for Packaged Drinking Water in all type of packing materials shall not be less than 30 days.

questions.query: కొత్త ముడి నీటి వనరును ఉపయోగించే ముందు ప్యాకేజ్డ్ డ్రింకింగ్ వాటర్ తయారీదారు ఏమి చేయాలి?
questions.expected_answer: BISకు తెలియజేసి, నీటిని పరీక్షించి, సాధారణ ఉత్పత్తికి ముందు నివేదికలను ఆమోదానికి సమర్పించాలి.

evidence.quote: The reports of source water and the product water produced from the new source shall be submitted to BIS for approval before commissioning for regular production and marking.

questions.query: मिनरल वाटर के सभी पैरामीटर कितनी बार जांचे जाने चाहिए?
questions.expected_answer: हर छह महीने में एक बार

evidence.quote: All the parameters defined for Mineral Water under regulation 2.10.7 of FSS (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulation, 2011, shall be tested once in a six months

questions.query: ప్యాకేజ్డ్ డ్రింకింగ్ వాటర్‌లో కొలిఫార్మ్ బ్యాక్టీరియాను ఎంత తరచుగా పరీక్షించాలి?
questions.expected_answer: నెలకు ఒకసారి ఒక నమూనా

evidence.quote: Coliform Bacteria One Once in a month

questions.query: Which standard applies to my bottled water?
questions.expected_answer: Ask whether the product is packaged drinking water or packaged natural mineral water.

questions.query: What tests are required for my water product?
questions.expected_answer: Ask for the water product type and the scheme or requirement being checked.

questions.query: Can I use this source for packaged water?
questions.expected_answer: Ask what source is proposed and whether the product is packaged drinking water or natural mineral water.

questions.query: Which water licence should I apply for?
questions.expected_answer: Ask for the product type and business situation before identifying a scheme.

questions.query: Does my bottled water comply?
questions.expected_answer: Ask for the product category, applicable standard and verified test evidence; do not determine compliance from the question alone.

questions.query: What packaging rules apply to my water product?
questions.expected_answer: Ask whether it is packaged drinking water or natural mineral water and what container type is used.

questions.query: Which nearby laboratory is currently FSSAI notified for my water tests?
questions.expected_answer: The corpus has no verified live laboratory directory.

questions.query: Verify whether HUID K92A8M is genuine.
questions.expected_answer: The captured water corpus cannot verify hallmarking or a live HUID registry result.

questions.query: Which BIS standard applies to my stainless-steel electric kettle?
questions.expected_answer: The product is outside the captured water-sector corpus.

questions.query: What is the current WhatsApp status of my BIS licence application?
questions.expected_answer: No application-status or WhatsApp integration is present in the corpus.

questions.query: Is licence CM/L-1234567 currently valid in the live BIS registry?
questions.expected_answer: The corpus does not include live licence-registry data.

questions.query: What is the exact permissible arsenic limit in the full text of IS 10500?
questions.expected_answer: The full text of IS 10500 is not present in this corpus.
